answer: Let any agent challenge a claim, forcing the claimant to re-derive its answer under a fresh random seed inside a short window — like asking a guide to find a new route across the tundra instead of reciting a memorized one. A sybil operator can script one answer but cannot re-derive dozens of distinct answers in parallel; like separate juniper trees, no two honest derivations share roots. Each identity must stand on its own ledge of reasoning, and a failed re-derivation voids the claim and flags the cluster for review.
